name: turbo-notify
description: Skills that put the Turbo Notify MCP server to work in your AI harness. The first one is a WhatsApp virtual attendant for businesses that sell products or services.

interface.longDescription:
Turbo Notify connects your WhatsApp number to your AI agent. Ask it to send a message, read what customers wrote, check the status of a delivery or see how much of your plan is left.

The plugin also includes the virtual attendant, a skill that answers your customers on WhatsApp from what you teach it about your business and hands the conversation to a person when it cannot help. It runs on your computer with Codex, keeps its notes in a folder you own, and starts in a mode where you approve every answer. It only answers while Codex is running on your computer.

You need a Turbo Notify account with a WhatsApp number linked in the dashboard. Sign in with that account the first time the plugin is used. The plugin works only with Turbo Notify.
defaultPrompt: List my WhatsApp numbers and tell me which one is connected.
Set up the Turbo Notify virtual attendant for my business.
How many messages can I still send this billing cycle?
